english: For $a>0$, let $S_a$ denote the circle $(x-a)^{2}+y^{2}=\dfrac{a^{2}}{2}$, and let $\mathcal{F}=\left\{S_a:a>0\right\}$. Exactly two members of $\mathcal{F}$ pass through the point $P(5,2)$. If $m_1$ and $m_2$ are the slopes of the tangents to these two circles at $P$, then the value of $m_1m_2$ is ______.
hindi: $a>0$ के लिए माना कि $S_a$ वृत्त $(x-a)^{2}+y^{2}=\dfrac{a^{2}}{2}$ को दर्शाता है, तथा $\mathcal{F}=\left\{S_a:a>0\right\}$ है। $\mathcal{F}$ के ठीक दो सदस्य बिन्दु $P(5,2)$ से होकर जाते हैं। यदि $P$ पर इन दो वृत्तों की स्पर्श रेखाओं की प्रवणताएँ $m_1$ तथा $m_2$ हैं, तो $m_1m_2$ का मान ______ है।
solution: This is the differential equation of $\mathcal{F}$; at $P$ its two roots are the slopes of the two members through $P$:
(Check: $a=10\pm\sqrt{42}$, both positive, so both members exist)
solution_full: Differentiate the equation of $S_a$ with respect to $x$: $2(x-a)+2y\dfrac{dy}{dx}=0$, so with $p=\dfrac{dy}{dx}$, $x-a=-yp$ and $a=x+yp$.

Multiply by $2$ and expand: $2y^{2}p^{2}+2y^{2}=x^{2}+2xyp+y^{2}p^{2}$, so $y^{2}p^{2}-2xyp+2y^{2}-x^{2}=0$. This is the differential equation of the family; it is quadratic in $p$, matching the fact that two members can pass through one point.
At $P(5,2)$: $4p^{2}-20p+8-25=0$, that is, $4p^{2}-20p-17=0$. Its roots are the slopes $m_1,m_2$ of the members through $P$.

Check that both members are admissible: $(5-a)^{2}+4=\dfrac{a^{2}}{2}$ gives $a^{2}-20a+58=0$, $a=10\pm\sqrt{42}$, both positive. The slopes $\dfrac{a-5}{2}$ give the same product $\dfrac{(a_1-5)(a_2-5)}{4}=\dfrac{58-100+25}{4}=-\dfrac{17}{4}$.
originality_note: New: the differential equation of a one-parameter family of circles is quadratic in the slope, and its two roots at a point are the slopes of the two members through that point (way 5). Closest known: forming the DE of circles with centres on the x-axis. Different because: the radius depends on the centre (a/sqrt 2) and the product of slopes is read from the DE with Vieta.
blueprint_concepts: Formation of a differential equation by eliminating arbitrary constants

concept_use.Formation of a differential equation by: Eliminating a from the circle and its derivative gives the differential equation y^2p^2 - 2xyp + 2y^2 - x^2 = 0 of the family, whose two roots at P are the required slopes.

stem_review: Read as a student: every symbol and function introduced with its domain, conditions complete, one reading of each sentence; answer recomputed with sympy and unique; a > 0 stated; both members through P exist (a = 10 +- sqrt 42 > 0); answer -4.25 is a negative decimal, exact, as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Eliminate a to get a DE quadratic in p; product of roots at P.
justification: Formation of the DE plus Vieta; a routine chain with one natural observation. Comparable to 2025-P2-Q9 (L2), a DE evaluated at a point.
